title: No military service: turned down for stuttering
summary: He was rejected for the draft because of his stutter, but played army camps with Lucky.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years
story.community_name: Drafted: service bands, USO shows and the war years

blocks.x: I'd just like to get back here for a minute, Panama. We went through the 30's and the 40's and World War II. Do you have any record of any service in the United States Army or Navy, or any service experience at all?
No, I didn't have any experience -- I was turned down.
Yes, I was turned down because of my stuttering.
Okay. I just wanted to mention that in here about service experience.

Although, during the time of the war, I was with Lucky Millinder there, and we played at many army camps and navy bases during the war because that was the only way that we were able to get gas. (CUT)
